source_scope: Complete official GUNDAM SEED TV-series CHARACTER directory at the title route /seed/seed/character/; exact scope is the 38 Japanese named entries displayed under GUNDAM SEED only, from キラ・ヤマト through パトリック・ザラ. notes: No expansion to Gundam franchise root, DESTINY, Stargazer, or characters absent from this directory.
